chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God have Mercy upon him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Bakr ibn Salih, on the authority of al-Hasan ibn Ali, on the authority of Abdullah, who said: Al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfaly narrated to me, on the authority of Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, on the authority of Ja'far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of Ali (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said:
The most wicked people in my nation are those who are respected for fear of their wickedness. Whoever the people respect due to fear of his wickedness is not from my nation.

key_terms.شِرَارَ: The worst or most wicked people

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean by 'the most wicked of my nation' in this hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this hadith to critique the social phenomenon of 'respect for status' rather than 'respect for virtue,' a concept deeply resonant in Shia ethical discourse regarding the hypocrisy of the elite. The Prophet’s declaration 'not from me' serves as a spiritual disavowal of those whose authority is maintained through fear (*ittiqā’ al-sharr*) rather than moral excellence, contrasting with the Shia ideal of leadership based on *‘ilm* and *‘adl*. This distinction underscores the importance of evaluating leaders and community figures by their intrinsic character rather than their coercive power.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-49 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God have Mercy upon him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Bakr ibn Salih, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Ali, on the authority of Abdullah , on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Yazid al-Nawfaly, on theauthority of Isma’il ibn Abi Zyad , on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers, on the authority of Ali (MGB) that the Prophet (MGB) said, “
The most wicked people in my nation are those who are respected for fear of their wickedness. Whoever the people respect due to fear of his wickedness is not from my nation.”
